children: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance will redeem all $400 million of its 5.60% Medium-Term Notes due 2026 on Oct. 13, 2026.
Redeeming $400 million of 5.60% Medium-Term Notes (CUSIP 63743HFK3) at par plus accrued interest.
Redemption date is October 13, 2026; payment of principal and accrued interest will be made from cash on hand.
Redemption is being effected to reduce interest expense, per the filing.
